name: microservices-and-ci-cd-lab-tests
description: Public checks for the Microservices and CI/CD module lab. Most read files as text and YAML; tests 24-26 run the reviews service against an in-process stand-in shop api, and tests 6-7 run the workflow's secret-using steps with made-up secrets and a stand-in docker. No container engine or network is used after setup.
